title: Buddha Was Closing His Eyes from Everything but His Lord
body:
Dastoor ya Sayyidee, madad! Allahu akbar. Yaa Fattah. Ya Allah. Ya Rabbana rabbi 'ghfir w 'arham. Laa
ilaaha illa-Llah anta khayru raahimeen. Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Laa ilaaha illa-Llah.
La ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun Rasoolullah (s), Sayyidi 'l-awwaleen wa’l-aakhireen. Madad yaa saahib 'l
waqt, madad yaa rijaalAllah, yaa sahib 'l imdaad, madad! As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa
barakaatuh.
You are poor listeners and I am a weak servant! We are really in need of heavenly support. We are going to
finish and vanish.
Laa hawla wa laa quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyi 'l-`Adheem 3x
O People! Don't trust yourselves, you are weak ones; trust only a representative of our Lord. He is the only
one in the Divine Presence and he is over the whole Creation, authorized to order or to prevent according to
the will of the Lord of Heavens.
O People! As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh. This salaam is a heavenly support to you
and to everyone. Therefore, Allah Almighty is ordering His servants to give us those holy words and to

address to each other with as-salaamu `alaykum. That is not a material thing, but it is a heavenly gift that has
been granted to weak servants. Therefore we are saying, as-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa
barakaatuh.
Listen and obey; listen and follow; listen and learn; listen and try to be honored ones. Salaam gives to all
Mankind heavenly support, heavenly honor, heavenly pleasure, and heavenly satisfaction. We may speak on
salaam from now up to next week, it is never ending. O People! Give salaam to each other. Therefore, we are
saying as-salaamu `alaykum. I am a weak one but when you are saying, wa`alaykum as-salaam, I am taking a
support because the Lord of Heavens is giving support for His chosen people through salaams, coming and
making it to go up.
O people, after salaam we are making a familiarity between ourselves. You are my Lords' servants and I am
also a weak servant. I am one from your crowd and you are giving me through your wa`alaykum as-salaam a
kind of support to address you; there is coming heavenly support. We are saying first of all to take away, as
we can’t pray without ablution; we must be clean for praying. Also, when you are saying to me as-salaamu
`alaykum, an ablution, a cleanliness is coming on me and on you. We are in need of an ablution. When you
are saying a`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani 'r-rajeem, it is a cleaning of ourselves. Then we may say,
bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem, “By the Name of Allah Almighty, All Merciful, Munificent and
Beneficent,” and we are beginning and at full speed we may go on. That means the way is open, go on!
O People! `ilmu 'l bahru laa yudraku, “Knowledge is an unreachable ocean,” that you can’t find an end and
you can't find a depth. I am sitting here and from those endless, heavenly knowledge oceans, looking at
something that is prepared for us now. I was trying to prepare myself for speaking and addressing people, but
they are saying, “No need, finished. Trust on our heavenly power, and you should be in rest.” Today I am
looking at what is coming and we may speak on it. Endless oceans of knowledge, Allah, Allah. O our Lord, O
our Lord, we are ashaming. I am ashaming to ask anything because You are giving and giving, (and saying,)
“Take as much as you like.”
Once upon a time, a sultan was inspecting his capital to see the position of his people. He saw one person, a
blind beggar. He ordered his servants, “Take him to my treasure, give him a shovel and let him take how
much he can carry on the shovel to be for him.”

That person was bringing a heap of gold and saying to him, “Take the shovel and take how much you can
carry on it.” He may take it; it is for him.
That blind person is coming, saying, “What am I doing now?”
“Take the shovel and in front of you is a heap of gold.”
Yes. He was trying to take it, but he was using the shovel upside down. Nothing. He was coming a second
time and trying once again. He was carrying that shovel, but nothing on it three times, and the sultan was
saying, “What can I do if the Lord of Heavens is not happy to give to you? What can I do? But give something
to him and send him away.”
Now so many people are coming and asking to hear, yes. Some of them are bringing shovels and their eyes
are open, taking. Some of them are looking here, looking there and taking nothing; perhaps one or two words
they may keep. But who is the looking-one, coming with a shovel to take from a heap of gold, to reach
something from heavenly knowledge oceans, who is taking care to take? Some of them are bringing a little
cup and taking from that ocean, some of them are bringing big cups and taking much more.
O People! O my listeners, you are listening to heavenly knowledge! Therefore, be careful! Such a message
now, very, very, very rare! It is a grant from the Lord of Heavens to His servants because they lost the ways of
Heavens. The Lord of Heavens is asking to show them real ways. I don’t know how many through east and
west making naseehat (advise), such a declaration and advising people. Subhaanallah. That instrument in
front of me, what is its name? Camera. The camera is listening more than people! It has much more care not
to lose any word from me! This man-made instrument is taking and giving to you. How are you sitting there,
hearing and taking nothing? What is that? Why is even one not taking? Perhaps one seed may be a big
gigantic tree and grow quickly through your real being. Take care. Don’t say, “I don’t care.” If you are saying,
“I don’t care,” heavens are saying, “We are also not taking care for that idiot one, ghafil, or heedless person.
Even one word keep it, write it down. (You must be thinking,) “I heard today something that may be useful
for me for a lifetime.” Therefore, please give a little bit of attention; that makes me speak much more clearly
and easily.
O People! Marhaba (welcome) to who is listening and saying, “Well done!” and knowing that reality is
speaking. I hope the Lord of Heavens and His representatives never giving wrong things. So many kinds of
jewels are coming to you, that you may take just one or two and it is okay if you are not taking all. Everyone

likes to have a treasure, yes it is true, but use your mind. Which treasure do you like for yourselves, a
temporary or permanent one? You should say, “No doubt I like a permanent treasure.” Okay, what do you
think if you are going to be mukhayyar (to have the choice), to leave it up to your will, O our Lord’s servant?
For your life, are you asking to be granted a temporary life full of enjoyment, or a permanent life? Which of
you will say, “I like temporary and not permanent?” Why you are not using your minds? All of you are
running after temporary treasures! Why are you not running after permanent treasures? How are you using
your minds? If a person is not using his mind, their level is under the level of animals. Yes, this is important.
You must have a choice, to choose this or that. For everything, you must give that measure. (Ask yourselves,)
“Am I prefering a temporary capital or permanent? If I am doing this, is it only for a temporary time or
forever?” Use your mind, O Mankind!
I know nothing, but they are making me to address to you. No one can object on these words, even holy ones
from popes, bishops, rabbis and other religious people. No one can be able to object on such a reality! Their
objection coming on realities, not coming on me, no! I am someone who is only transferring to you from
heavenly realities. Use your mind, and choose which one for you: permanent or temporary? (Mawlana claps
his hands.) Mashaa-Allah. Where are our shaykhs? Where are our proud Salafi people? Where are our Azhari
(al-Azhar University) people? Where are our Wahhabi `ulama?
Where are our Buddhists, proud chiefs, who are asking Tibet only to be for themselves? Make yourself
independent first, then the whole world is going to be independent for you. So many people making their
clothes like this. (Mawlana gestures sparse clothing.) Before 5000 years ago, giving nothing to them. I am
asking Dalai Lama, I know his name; I am calling, “Come and speak, what is your aim to be a Buddhist one?
Why you are saying that your lord is Buddha? Which benefit is coming to you from him?” Ask to them if that
very small, unknown person, “What do you think about him?” Ask him, “What do you think about that
servant?” Everyday, with a hammer hitting our heads, we can’t find any answer.
Now he is beginning to ask Dalai Lama, then he may ask Buddha. I don’t think Buddha may give to them an
answer because every statue of Buddha is sleeping. I am asking, why sleeping? They are saying, “He is doing
meditation.” Sleeping people making meditation, what is that? For whom Buddha was making meditation, to
himself or to someone else? Say, “Come to reality.” You must come or the power going on them. Don’t ask
Tibet to be a free canton, through China or over India, no. You are not going to be changed if you are going to

be under command of the Chinese government or Indian government. When you are going to be a free,
Tibetan, Buddhist republic, what will happen? You are changing your clothes, changing your minds? No.
Why you are objecting? You are asking Buddha if you are living in our ways, are you happy or not? You may
ask Buddha. What is your opinion if you are asking a free Buddhistan, like Hindustan, like Turkistan, like
`Ajemistan, like Afghanistan? What happened (when they became independent)? Nothing happened.
O People! This is a (spiritual) "whip" coming from the heavens. If you are not thinking on it, then coming on
you. I am, therefore, giving a warning to you. Change your minds! You may dress any dress, it doesn’t matter,
but you must change your mind and your understanding in front of real realities! Real realities coming from
prophets and from heavens. If you are saying Buddha was a chosen one from heavens, he warned you, but
you are not understanding. He was closing his eyes from everything occupying man away from his Lord.
Therefore, making to teach you and you, Dalai Lama, are asking a Tibet Republic for Buddhist people? In
which book is Buddha speaking this to you? He did it? No, never! May Allah forgive us.
Dome dome dome dome
(37 minutes)
Yes, O people, that they are making a weakest servant to speak. No one can object or face these real realities.
No one can refuse or bring an objection. You can bring an objection, yes, but what is your point, I may ask? I
made their proofs to be ashes! Someone bringing to me ashes and I am asking, “For what these ashes you are
bringing to me?” I was keeping here, but some people bringing ashes for me. (Mawlana displays an urn.)
What is the benefit of this, but I am keeping this to show people and their understanding level. Yes, look. You
can’t eat it, if putting on eyes going to be blind, if throwing, ants running away! For what, this? People just
lost their ways, lost realities!
Shaytan in countless ways making people to run after his false and wrong ideas. The leader of falsehood,
Shaytan, asking to carry all people after his false ideas. Wrong ideas, never happened right ideas but touching
imagination of people. So many schools of different ideas you can find. (Mawlana Shaykh mimics) “If you like
to learn, pay some money, we shall take you inside to teach you something. First, how you are going to sit to
make meditation.” Yes, they are saying this. Making people to leave reality, but people mostly they are
heedless, only asking for delights of this life and nothing else. Leaving real treasure and running after

temporary pleasure.
O People! You must come; time is over and the Last Day is coming. The Day of Judgment is coming. Day of
Resurrection is coming. Beware, take your honor. Try to learn for what you have been in existence, or you
should be regretting. O People! I am only a weak one, but the Lord of Heavens giving to you such an
authority, speaking here! Through east and west people may listen, yes sir!
(Mawlana sings)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah 4x
Dome dome dome dome 8x
Fatihah. (43 minutes)
Okay, enough. Thank you for our listeners. Allah gives them holy power from heavens, for understanding
such holy words. It is not from me but they are making me to speak and to address you. O Mankind, I am a
very weak servant! Thank you for your listening. May Allah grants you from His endless Mercy Oceans and
blessings come to you.
Fatihah. (45 minutes now, 326.000 viewers!) Okay. Should listen whole world bi'amrillah, by His holy order
of heavens.
